title: OpenAI background polling requests encrypted content for persisted responses
author: mike-hoyle

comments.author: pydanty[bot]
comments.body:
<!-- pydanty:status-comment:v1 -->

## pydanty status: bug -- confirmed (high), signal 7/10 - p:2-high

**Why:** OpenAI background mode (a recently added feature) is broken for all reasoning models when responses are persisted (the default). Users cannot use background mode with durable response-ID continuation without hitting a 400 error on the first poll. The workaround (openai_store=False) sacrifices continuation, which is a core benefit of persisted responses. This affects Tier-1 provider (OpenAI) on a non-default but recently shipped feature path.
**Evidence:** Code_librarian confirmed from checked-in source (pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/models/openai.py): (1) _build_include() (line 2497) unconditionally appends 'reasoning.encrypted_content' when profile flag openai_supports_encrypted_reasoning_content is True — no store-aware or retrieve-vs-create guard. (2) This same include list is shared by _responses_create() (line 2423) and _responses_retrieve() (line 2542). (3) _responses_retrieve() (line 2533) calls responses.retrieve() with include=include or OMIT (line 2548) but does NOT pass store. (4) openai_store defaults to None (OMIT) → OpenAI persists server-side. (5) OpenAI API rejects retrieve with reasoning.encrypted_content for persisted responses with 400 "Encrypted content cannot be requested for persisted responses." Bug present in current checked-in code (2.13.0), not just reported 2.10.0. Reproducer delegate was unavailable this run due to budget exhaustion; no live provider call was made. The code-level mechanism is sufficient to confirm the defect without runtime verification.
**Next:** pr_ready -- Bug mechanism confirmed from code reading (code_librarian, high confidence); reproducer was unavailable due to budget limits, not missing evidence. The defect is a parameter-construction issue visible in checked-in source: _build_include() unconditionally adds reasoning.encrypted_content for both create and retrieve, with no store-aware guard. PR-ready handoff written; reproduction gap stated in status comment.

@adtyavrdhn -- assigned for prioritization (p:2-high, signal 7/10).
